rawContent: Happy New Year! 2020 was a challenge for everyone, but after a year off due to COVID & maternity leave, we’re pleased to announce a new season of online events addressing sexual assault & abuse. Details coming later in January! #endVAWG #MeToo #StrongerTogether https://t.co/dphyvmEthr

After a year off (due to maternity leave, Covid, etc) we're back - with a new season of online events! Starting with our free #creativewriting workshops for survivors, Feb 10 & 12. Read our latest newsletter 👇👇 #MeToo #endVAWG  https://t.co/XaJTfQA5vR https://t.co/JRhlNQhKDG

Both our original co-founders @winniemli & @NinaBurrowes will be speaking at #svconf21 this week, which is sold out! Looking forward to hearing Nina speak soon - Winnie is on tomorrow! #ItsNotOk #MeToo

SAVE THE DATE for our first public event of 2021!  💪 Wednesday, March 3rd at 5pm GMT is our #free online event, an exciting collaboration with academics & survivor-centred activism on sexual violence.  More details to be announced next week! #endVAWG #itsnotok #MeToo #feminism https://t.co/ySekLtAtm2

More details to be announced this week for our first public event of the year! 📢📢📢 In the meantime, save the date: Wednesday, March 3rd, 5pm GMT. It will be #free and online #itsnotok #feminism #activism #endVAWG #MeToo https://t.co/WKws2L6Ant

Huge congrats to our Co-Founder @winniemli for her amazing book deal!!! Her next novel #Complicit is out next year & tells a riveting #MeToo story set in the film industry. We can’t wait to read it 👍 Her debut #DarkChapter was a remarkable account of rape, trauma & recovery
This event is TONIGHT! 200 of you have booked to hear our panel on Sexual Violence & Criminal Justice. Looking forward to it! #endVAWG #MeToo

‘Our greatest fear as victims is that we’re simply being processed by the system.’ Our @winniemli spoke yesterday to social workers, forensic scientists, police & other #vawg professionals at #stmarysconf2021 @StmarysSARC on the role of the arts in exposing our humanity #MeToo https://t.co/GXutCsdm8d
